requirements.heading: Definition
requirements.text: The value associated with this item in the header field MUST be at least the first eight characters of the digital signature (the "b=" tag from a DKIM-Signature) for which a result is being relayed, and MUST be long enough to be unique among the results being reported.

requirements.heading: Definition
requirements.text: Where the total length of the digital signature is fewer than eight characters, the entire signature MUST be included.

requirements.heading: Definition
requirements.text: Matching of the value of this item against the signature itself MUST be case-sensitive.

requirements.heading: Definition
requirements.text: If an evaluating agent observes that, despite the use of this disambiguating tag, unequal authentication results are offered about the same signature from the same trusted authserv-id, that agent SHOULD ignore all such results.
